issues.message: card someone 表示查验证件以核实年龄，不是“登记身份”。
卡片与纸牌合并后，各自只有一个例句。须分开教学，并为每个核心义保留至少两个例句。
身份、资格卡不宜列为较少见义；常用的银行卡支付功能以及英式不可数材料义“卡纸”也未充分覆盖。
词条所列的明信片、梳理纤维的器具及动词、建卡和记卡用法未得到实际例句覆盖。
原例仅表示节目安排印在普通卡片上，没有展示 card 自身表示节目单或赛事安排的用法；标题中的菜单义也没有得到说明。
查证件义应标明主要见于美式口语；card someone for ID 信息重复，教学首选搭配宜改为 get carded。
card 中 r 位于 d 前，并非词尾；应准确说明非卷舌英式与美式读音的区别。
Cambridge 页面未取得正文，不能作为本次审校的实质依据。删除该来源引用；已有材料支持的内容改引对应来源，其余按专业语言知识处理。
cards 也可能是动词第三人称单数，不能仅凭词尾 -s 判断为名词；拆分义项后，相关例句的 senseId 也须同步调整。
carding 本身不表示“正在”；进行意义须由相应句法结构表达。原警卫查访客证件的例句也未明确年龄核验语境。
应区分屈折变化与复合构词，并补充常用复合词及其实际拼写。
古法语阶段的 meaning 是空洞占位说明，应删除该阶段并把可证实字形保留在摘要；补明先有纸牌义、后扩展至其他纸卡的顺序，并引用支持古法语来源的同 URL 材料。
若干例句缺少结构要求的 note 字段，须在保留例句的同时补齐。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对词条列出的卡片、纸牌、节目单、明信片、梳棉器具、建卡记卡及梳理纤维用法，并核对补充材料中的年龄核验动词义。补丁将日常证件卡、支付卡和英式卡纸义纳入核心教学，各核心义均有至少两个例句；较少见义保留简明例句，并补充材料中列出的电子卡件与体育罚牌用法。历史说明仅采用已取得的两份词源材料，不推测梳理纤维一词的进一步来源；不穷举所有行业细义和固定短语。

senseInventory.assessment: 保留原生日卡例句，另补普通信息卡例句，与纸牌义分开。

senseInventory.sense: 可数名词：纸牌；复数 cards 表示纸牌游戏
senseInventory.assessment: 独立成义，覆盖一张牌、一副牌和 play cards。

senseInventory.sense: 可数名词：身份、会员等资格卡
senseInventory.assessment: 由较少见义提升为核心义，补足两个例句。

senseInventory.sense: 可数名词：银行卡、支付卡及刷卡付款功能
senseInventory.assessment: 补充核心义，说明 pay by card 与 pay with a card 的结构差别。

senseInventory.sense: 不可数名词：卡纸、厚纸，主要用于英式英语
senseInventory.assessment: 补充材料义及 a piece of card，避免与一张成品卡片混淆。

senseInventory.sense: 名词：语境明确时指明信片
senseInventory.assessment: 补充裸词 card 指明信片的例句，不仅列出 postcard 这个复合词。

senseInventory.sense: 名词：赛事节目单、赛事安排
senseInventory.assessment: 改用 card 自身表示赛事安排的自然例句，并说明普通演出节目单更常用 programme/program。

senseInventory.sense: 名词：梳理纤维的器具，包括梳棉机
senseInventory.assessment: 补入专业义，并与纸片义的词源区分。

senseInventory.sense: 及物动词：为对象建卡、把资料记在卡片上
senseInventory.assessment: 以较旧的编目用法保留，避免误解为现代通用的登记动词。

senseInventory.sense: 及物动词：梳理羊毛、棉花等纤维
senseInventory.assessment: 补入纺织专业义及明确宾语。

senseInventory.sense: 及物动词：查验证件以核实年龄
senseInventory.assessment: 保留两个例句，补明主要用于美式口语，修正标题误释。
简要补充来源衍生词表涉及的常见技术用途。

senseInventory.sense: 名词：体育比赛中的罚牌
senseInventory.assessment: 简要说明 red card、yellow card 所属语境。

{"id":"card-noun-sports","title":"体育比赛中的罚牌","meaning":"裁判用来警告或处罚运动员的牌。","note":"常见于足球等项目的 yellow card（黄牌）和 red card（红牌）。","example":{"id":"card-sports-ex1","senseId":"card-noun-sports","en":"The referee showed him a yellow card for the foul.","zh":"裁判因他犯规而向他出示了一张黄牌。","note":"show someone a card 表示向某人出示罚牌。"},"sourceIds":["src-wiktionary-en"]}

{"id":"card-noun-playing","title":"纸牌；纸牌游戏","meaning":"可数名词，指玩牌用的一张牌；复数 cards 也可指打牌这种活动。","usageNote":"a card 是一张牌，a pack/deck of cards 是一副牌；play cards 表示打牌，不能用 play a card 代替，后者通常表示打出一张牌。","examples":[{"id":"card-paper-ex2","senseId":"card-noun-playing","en":"He drew the queen of hearts from the pack of cards.","zh":"他从一副纸牌中抽到了红桃皇后。","note":"pack of cards 指一副纸牌。"},{"id":"card-playing-ex2","senseId":"card-noun-playing","en":"We played cards after dinner.","zh":"晚饭后我们打了牌。","note":"play cards 表示打牌，用复数 cards，前面不加冠词。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"play cards","zh":"打牌","note":"表示进行纸牌游戏。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a pack/deck of cards","zh":"一副纸牌","note":"pack 常见于英式英语，deck 常见于美式英语。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"draw a card","zh":"抽一张牌","note":"强调从牌堆中抽牌。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"collocations":[{"en":"shuffle the cards","zh":"洗牌","note":"把牌的顺序打乱。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"deal the cards","zh":"发牌","note":"把牌分发给玩家。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"playing card","zh":"纸牌","note":"明确说明是玩牌用的牌，避免与贺卡等混淆。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"playing card 对应本义；play cards 中的 cards 表示活动，不能直接替换成单数 playing card。","contrastingNote":"纸牌作为实物名词没有固定反义词；输赢、牌面大小不是 card 的反义。"},"sourceIds":["src-wiktionary-en"]}

{"id":"card-noun-identification","title":"身份、资格卡","meaning":"证明身份、会员资格或某种使用权限的卡，是可数名词。","usageNote":"常见表达有 identity/ID card 和 membership card。种类明确时也可简称 card，如在会员入口问 Can I see your card?","examples":[{"id":"card-lesser-ex1","senseId":"card-noun-identification","en":"Please show your membership card at the door.","zh":"请在门口出示你的会员卡。","note":"membership card 证明会员资格。"},{"id":"card-identification-ex2","senseId":"card-noun-identification","en":"The receptionist checked my ID card before giving me a room key.","zh":"前台接待核对了我的身份证件后，才给我房间钥匙。","note":"先核对身份证件，再交付钥匙；check an ID card 是通用表达。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"show someone your card","zh":"向某人出示你的卡","note":"卡的具体类型由场景决定，不一定是身份证。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"identity card / ID card","zh":"身份证件；身份证","note":"具体证件形式随地区而异。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"membership card","zh":"会员卡","note":"证明持有人的会员资格。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"ID","zh":"身份证明；身份证件","note":"范围比 ID card 广，也可包括护照等证件。"},{"en":"pass","zh":"通行证；入场凭证","note":"仅在证明通行或入场权限时与某些 card 接近，不一定采用卡片形式。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"ID 和 pass 只在相应身份或权限语境中接近 card，不能替换所有卡片。","contrastingNote":"证件类实物名词没有固定反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"card-noun-payment","title":"银行卡；支付卡","meaning":"用于支付或银行业务的卡，常见的有信用卡和借记卡。","usageNote":"支付场景中 card 可直接理解为支付卡。pay by card 表示用卡付款；也可说 pay with a card 或 pay with my card。","examples":[{"id":"card-payment-ex1","senseId":"card-noun-payment","en":"I paid for lunch by card.","zh":"我用银行卡付了午餐的钱。","note":"by card 表示支付方式，card 前不加冠词。"},{"id":"card-payment-ex2","senseId":"card-noun-payment","en":"The shop doesn't accept credit cards.","zh":"这家商店不接受信用卡。","note":"credit cards 用复数泛指信用卡。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"pay by card / pay with a card","zh":"用卡付款","note":"by card 中不用冠词；with 后的单数 card 要有 a、my 等限定词。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"credit card","zh":"信用卡","note":"使用授信额度付款，之后按约定还款。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"debit card","zh":"借记卡","note":"付款通常从关联账户扣款。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"accept cards","zh":"接受用卡支付","note":"常用于商店、餐馆等说明支付方式。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"credit card","zh":"信用卡","note":"是支付卡的一类，不能代指所有银行卡。"},{"en":"debit card","zh":"借记卡","note":"也是支付卡的一类，与信用卡的资金来源不同。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"pay in cash","zh":"用现金付款","note":"在支付方式上与 pay by card 形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"credit card 和 debit card 都属于本义，但两者不能不加区分地互换。","contrastingNote":"现金与卡只在支付方式上构成对照；cash 不是其他 card 义的反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"card-noun-material","title":"卡纸；厚纸","meaning":"主要用于英式英语，指制作卡片、模型等的较厚硬纸，作不可数名词。","usageNote":"材料义说 some card、a piece of card 或 a sheet of card；a card 通常表示一张成品卡片。","examples":[{"id":"card-material-ex1","senseId":"card-noun-material","en":"We need some white card for the school project.","zh":"我们做学校课题需要一些白色卡纸。","note":"some card 表示一定量的材料，不是一张张成品卡片。"},{"id":"card-material-ex2","senseId":"card-noun-material","en":"Cut a circle out of a piece of card.","zh":"从一片卡纸上剪出一个圆形。","note":"用 a piece of 表示一片不可数材料。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a piece/sheet of card","zh":"一片／一张卡纸","note":"量词后才可计数，如 two sheets of card。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"coloured card","zh":"彩色卡纸","note":"常见于手工制作场景；coloured 是英式拼写。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"cardboard","zh":"纸板","note":"与 card 在材料上有重叠，通常更常用于较厚纸板或包装材料。"},{"en":"paper","zh":"纸","note":"是范围更广的材料名称，不一定具有 card 的厚度和硬度。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"card 与 cardboard 有时可以近义使用，但具体材料厚度和用途仍须看语境；paper 不是所有情况下都能替换 card。","contrastingNote":"这种材料名词没有固定反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}
